dataset_name: Hospital Nurses Stress Dataset (Hosseini et al., Scientific Data 2022)
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (Dryad Public Domain Dedication) / Scientific Data Open Access (CC BY 4.0)

label_reliability_findings.generation_mechanism: Candidate stress intervals were generated by an upstream EDA/physiological algorithm or end-of-shift retrospective survey recall, then rated by nurses (0=no stress, 1=moderate, 2=high, na=unconfirmed).
label_reliability_findings.scientific_implication: Because start times are rounded to the minute (+-60s) and influenced by upstream physiological detection boundaries, P0/P1/P2 forecasting evaluates prediction of survey-validated physiological/perceived stress episode boundaries rather than independent video-coded behavioral meltdown onsets.
